resources.string: Select your board to avoid interference.
The app needs Bluetooth permission to find your scoreboard.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to find scoreboards.
Make sure your scoreboard is powered on and nearby.
Power on your scoreboard. Its LED blinks blue while it waits for your phone.
Keep your phone close and Bluetooth on. Your board appears in this list.
Tap Link Display. The LED turns solid green when you are connected.
If the link drops, the clock keeps running on your phone and the board relinks by itself.
Board firmware is outdated. Update it to use all features.
Board not ready for renaming (firmware update needed?)
Update the board firmware to show emoji in team names on the board.
Simulation only. No board is linked.
Update the board firmware to change colors.
Alerts also play on the board when it is linked.
Update the board firmware to show the icon on the board.
The goal alert uses the game start alert\'s color and switch.
Switch an element off to hide it on the panel. The timer switch hides it whether it is running or stopped.
Update the board firmware to hide elements on the board. The preview already hides them.
Colors are saved on the board and sent again each time you connect.
The panel shows 65,536 colors, so very close shades can look the same.
Shows the scores, period and countdown in an ongoing notification and on the lock screen, so you can switch apps or take a call without losing the match.

Pair and connect your Bluetooth speaker in Settings; the announcements play wherever the phone plays media. Audio is spoken in the app\'s language; whistles and horns mark the start and end of periods and of the match.
For a more natural voice, install a high-quality voice for your language in Settings > Text-to-speech output. It shows up here, and Automatic picks the best one installed.
Banner shows on the phone (and taps the watch); Panel shows on the board. The play button tries an event.
Minutes before the end of the period.
Only times shorter than the period are announced, once each, as the clock passes them.
A newer firmware is available for this board.
This board needs a one-time USB update before it can update over Bluetooth.
This copy of the app does not include a firmware image. Build it with tools/bundle-firmware.sh.
The firmware in this app has no update key. Rebuild it with tools/bundle-firmware.sh.
Done. The board is restarting with the new firmware.

Keep the phone next to the board and this screen open. It takes one to three minutes, the panel shows a progress bar, and the board restarts when it is done. If anything goes wrong the board keeps its current firmware.
The Bluetooth connection was lost during the update.
The update stalled. Move the phone closer to the board and try again.
The board did not accept this app\'s update key. Rebuild the app with tools/bundle-firmware.sh after flashing the board.
The board is locked for 30 seconds after failed tries. Wait and try again.
The firmware does not fit on the board.
The board could not write the firmware.
The firmware did not pass the board\'s check, so nothing was changed.
The board was busy. Try again.
Power on the board and open the app. The radar searches for nearby scoreboards. The board\'s LED blinks blue while it waits.
Tap Link Display next to your board. At a venue with several courts, pick the name of your own board. The LED turns solid green.
Use the + and − buttons for the score and Start, Pause and Reset for the clock. The timer runs on your phone, so the game keeps going if the link drops.
Choose the period, the number of periods and the panel brightness. Rename the period unit (Quarter, Half, Tiempo) and the board from the top card.

Tap Panel Colors in the top card. Pick the color of the timer (running and stopped), the period, each team\'s name and score, and the two start alerts. Use the switch on a row to hide that element on the panel; an alert you switch off does not play. The preview shows the panel as you choose, and the board remembers your choices.

When a game or a period starts, the panel flashes its border and scrolls a message across it in the color you chose. On the Alerts and Sound page, choose for each event (goal, time left, start and end of periods, half time, end of match) whether it is spoken, shown on the phone and shown on the panel.

The watch app lets you add or subtract points, change the period and start or pause the clock from your wrist. It follows your phone, so both always show the same score. Your watch taps and shows a banner when a period starts and when the match ends.

No board at hand? Tap Try the simulated board on the Find Scoreboards screen. At the bottom of the match screen, a simulated panel shows what the real board shows: scores, clock, period, names, your colors and the alerts. With a real board linked it mirrors the board and shows whether the two are in sync.

On the match screen, turn the phone sideways: the simulated panel fills the screen with score, period and clock controls below, and the screen stays on. The phone becomes the scoreboard if the real panel does not work.

With a board linked, Board Firmware shows its version and updates it over Bluetooth. The globe button switches the app between English and Spanish or follows the phone; the board\'s alerts and the watch follow it too.
